paragraphs: Rav Acha bar Rav Ketina: Yevamot 66a.
Rav Daniel bar Rav Ketina: Taanit 9b.
Rav Huna bar Rav Ketina: Nedarim 65b.
Rav Chana bar Rav Ketina: Yoma 54a.
Rav Chanan bar Rav Ketina: Chullin 19a.
Rav Tuvi son of Rav Ketina: Niddah 6b.
Rav Shmuel bar Rav Ketina: Berakhot 47a.

notes.text: Saved Davidson Yoma 54a fully writes Rav Chana bar Rav Ketina, supporting Rav in p004. No global Rav/Rabbi normalization is implied.

The consulted Taanit 9b reads Rav Daniel bar Ketina, without the second Rav in Hyman’s supplied form. The supplied form is preserved, and the collective heading does not establish that all these fathers were one person.
